verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing line on the ERISA & Executive Compensation page saying the firm is 'well versed in... UK incentives', alongside European offices in London, Munich and Paris. That signals advisory capability, not published guidance on specific instruments. The Founders Workbench founder content is Delaware/US-centric (Delaware formation, SAFEs). Missing for 10: published guides on UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules and French BSPCE, and any jurisdiction-specific founder resources outside the US.
